CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( TPB_TSM_Territory__c = $User.TPB_Territory__c, TPB_Account_Parent_Territory__c = $User.TPB_Territory__c,
AND( $User.Title = "NSD", LEFT($User.Territory_Id__c, 2) = LEFT(TPB_TSM_Territory__c, 2) ),
$Profile.Name = "System Administrator", $UserRole.Name = "Executive" ), 1, 0 )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Returns 1 if the record falls within the running user's territory scope (own territory, parent/NSM territory, or matching Director region) or if the user has elevated access (System Administrator or Executive role). Otherwise returns 0. Used for reporting and filtering.
CustomField.label: Belong to Running User Territory
